entities.name: Archaeal Rpo1N
observations: The 768-aa query has 40.9–43.4% identity over 97.9% query coverage to reviewed archaeal DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit Rpo1N homologs.
Reviewed homolog annotations describe an RNA polymerase component forming the clamp head domain and participating in DNA-dependent transcription.
Reviewed homolog annotations place the protein in the cytoplasm and DNA-directed RNA polymerase complex.
Query Pfam matches: RNA_pol_Rpb1_1 (14–346), RNA_pol_Rpb1_2 (348–513), RNA_pol_Rpb1_3 (516–675), RNA_pol_Rpb1_4 (700–768).
